Name: y_up_next
Data / Notes: Split-adjusted NVDA close (src 1). Equal closes are rare; treat as 0 and document.

Name: y_ret_next
Data / Notes: Same prices; regression target; label can be derived as sign.
Rationale: Enables magnitude-aware models and probability calibration checks.

Name: y_up_thresh
Definition: 1 if ln(close_{t+1}/close_t) > +k*sigma_t, 0 if < -k*sigma_t, else drop/neutral (sigma_t = nvda_rvol_20d/sqrt(252))
Data / Notes: Choose k by validation only (not on test).
Rationale: Reduces label noise from tiny moves.

Name: y_up_vs_qqq
Definition: 1 if NVDA next-day log return > QQQ next-day log return

Name: y_up_vs_smh
Definition: 1 if NVDA next-day log return > SMH next-day log return

Name: y_up_oc_next
Rationale: Tests intraday predictability separately from gap.

Name: y_gap_up_next
Data / Notes: Captures post-6 p.m. and pre-market news.
Rationale: Note: information between 6 p.m. and next open is unknown at t.

Name: y_3class
Definition: up / flat / down using +/- k*sigma_t bands

Name: n/a
Definition: Features dated t (as of 18:00 ET) map to label using t+1 = next trading session per trading calendar (src 25); skip weekends/holidays.
Data / Notes: Last row in sample has no label; drop it.
Rationale: Never use data timestamped after 18:00 ET on t.

Name: n/a
Definition: Report base rate of y_up_next per training window; evaluate with log-loss, Brier, AUC, and accuracy vs base rate.
Rationale: Up-day share is typically somewhat above 50% for a trending stock; compare against majority-class baseline.
